notes: Barron County zoning layer from the 2017 zoning map, hosted by the county GIS org (barronGIS); 1,562 polygons. Zone codes from ZoneCode (e.g. R1, R2); no zone name or jurisdiction field. Features carry parcel IDs, so polygons may be parcel-level zoning. Newer 2026 county zoning exists only as a download at geodata.wisc.edu.
